name: Twisted Sisters
title: Twisted Sisters Full Day
tagline: The bucket-list loop. RM 335, 336, and 337 through the Frio and Nueces canyons.
description: Leave Fredericksburg via TX 16, pick up the three sisters in Medina, and give the day to the canyons. This is the road everyone asks about — package it as a day that actually works from town.
routeLabel: FBG → Kerrville → Medina → Leakey → Camp Wood → home
stops: Lost Maples Country Store, Vanderpool — fuel, snacks, the pause before the hard miles
Bent Rim Grill / Frio Canyon Motorcycle Stop, Leakey — burgers, Frito pie, bike parking
The Hog Pen, RM 336 — BBQ and a beer if the hours line up (Wed / Fri–Sun)
gotchas: Fuel in Medina, Leakey, and Camp Wood. Blind crests, free-range cattle, thin shoulders. The Hog Pen is not daily. This is not a wine-tasting day. Already rode 335, 336, and 337? That is the Rocksprings / Highway 55 day.

name: Rocksprings / Highway 55
title: Rocksprings / Highway 55
tagline: The day after the sisters. SH 41 into Rocksprings, 55 down to Camp Wood, 337 back through Leakey.
description: West out of Kerrville on 27 to Mountain Home, then SH 41 across the Edwards Plateau and US 377 into Rocksprings. That outbound is open country, not the canyons. Lunch on the square. South on SH 55 to Camp Wood — sweepers, trucks, the Nueces. Then RM 337 east to Leakey, the sister you already rode, and home 337 through Medina. Skip 335 and 336 on purpose. Longer miles than the three-sisters day; 55 is the point.
routeLabel: FBG → Kerrville → 27 / 41 → Rocksprings → 55 → Camp Wood → 337 → Leakey → Medina → home
stops: Jailhouse Bar & Grill, 108 W Austin St, Rocksprings — lunch on the square. Confirm hours; closed Tuesday
King Burger, 102 Main St — the backup grill if Jailhouse is dark
Bent Rim Grill, Leakey — fuel and a pause after 337. You have been here
gotchas: Do not turn onto RM 335 at Barksdale — that is the sisters day. SH 41 is fast plateau; SH 55 has trucks and 70-mph stretches. Fuel in Rocksprings, Camp Wood, and Leakey. Jailhouse is closed Tuesday. Devil's Sinkhole is a side quest, not this drive. This is a long day from town.

name: Willow City Loop
title: Enchanted Rock + Willow City Loop
tagline: The local classic. FM 965 sweepers, granite, then the 13-mile Willow City ribbon.
timeLabel: Half day, or full with a Llano lunch
description: North on FM 965 to Enchanted Rock, then the Willow City Loop and home via FM 1323 or TX 16. The drive you can do after coffee and still make dinner in town.
routeLabel: FBG → FM 965 → Enchanted Rock → Willow City Loop → home
stops: Breakfast in Fredericksburg before you roll — spin the Restaurant Finder
Enchanted Rock State Natural Area — stretch, granite, photos
Back on Main for lunch, or push north to Cooper's in Llano if you want BBQ as the destination
gotchas: Spring wildflower weekends turn Willow City into a parking lot. Private ranch land — stay on the pavement. Cattle, cattle guards, and low-water crossings. East on 1323 past 1631 is the Horseshoe Bay day, not a longer loop.

name: Llano BBQ Run
title: Llano BBQ Run
tagline: Willow City or TX 16 north, then Cooper's. The food is the destination; the road is the excuse.
description: A Hill Country plate worth the tank of gas. Take TX 16 or peel onto Willow City, land in Llano for Cooper's, and roll home before dark.
routeLabel: FBG → TX 16 / Willow City → Llano → home
stops: Cooper's Old Time Pit Bar-B-Que, Llano — the pit stop that justifies the drive
Optional square-side stroll in Llano before the return
Evening pour back in Fredericksburg from the Bar Finder
gotchas: Cooper's lines on weekends. Leave early or eat a late lunch. Confirm hours before you commit the whole day to brisket.

name: Medina Apples
title: Medina Apple Country + 337 Warm-Up
tagline: Pie, cider country, and the friendliest sister. A taste of Twisted Sisters without the full commitment.
description: TX 16 to Kerrville, then Medina for Love Creek / the Apple Store. Continue onto RM 337 toward Vanderpool if the group is up for it — turn around if they are not.
stops: Love Creek Orchards / The Apple Store, Medina — pie and cider
Lost Maples Country Store if you continue west
Kerrville on the way home for a sit-down if the orchard is slammed
gotchas: Orchard hours and seasonal fruit. RM 337 west of Vanderpool ramps up fast. Confirm the Apple Store is open before you sell the day as a pie run.

name: Luckenbach
title: Luckenbach Backroads Afternoon
tagline: Short, pretty, and back in time for a brewery. The convertible cruise.
description: South and southeast farm roads to Luckenbach, home on backroads instead of 290. Proves the finder can do more than canyon-carving.
stops: Luckenbach Texas — the postcard stop, not the technical one
Friday–Sunday: Black Board Bar B Q is 15 minutes south on 1376 if you want lunch before the postcard
Spin the Bar Finder for a brewery or beer garden once you are back
gotchas: Weekend tour-bus energy at Luckenbach. Go early or on a weekday. Black Board in Sisterdale is Friday–Sunday only.

name: Blanco BBQ
title: Luckenbach to Blanco BBQ
tagline: Postcard Luckenbach, then RM 1888 to the Blanco square. Old 300 for lunch. Home on 1623 and 2721.
description: South to Luckenbach for the glance, then RM 1888 — River Road — the 16 miles of sweepers that motorcycle and sports-car people already know. Land on the Blanco square at Old 300 BBQ. Redbud Cafe is next door if the table wants a Reuben instead. Come home on RM 1623 along the Blanco River through Stonewall, then RM 2721 into Fredericksburg. That return is the point. Do not bail onto 290.
stops: Luckenbach — the postcard pause, then keep rolling. Lunch is in Blanco
Old 300 BBQ, 318 4th St — brisket on the courthouse square. Open daily; Sunday closes at 3
Redbud Cafe on the square — the Reuben if the group is not in a BBQ mood
gotchas: Sunday Old 300 closes at 3. Weekend Luckenbach tour buses — go through early. RM 1888 is quiet ranch road, not a canyon. The 1623 / 2721 return skips the 290 wine trail; do not cheat it.

name: Pedernales Cruise
title: Pedernales River Cruise
tagline: Ranch Road 1 along the river, LBJ country, Hye. Scenic, not spicy.
description: East toward Stonewall, peel onto Ranch Road 1 along the Pedernales, through LBJ country and Hye. A scenic loop for mixed groups who will not enjoy Twisted Sisters.
routeLabel: FBG → Ranch Road 1 → LBJ / Hye → home
stops: LBJ State Park & Historic Site — stretch and a view
Hye — a quick stop, then decide if you want wine-trail traffic or backroads home
Dinner back in Fredericksburg from the Restaurant Finder
gotchas: 290 wine-trail congestion on Saturdays. Ranch Road 1 is the point; 290 is the compromise.

name: Johnson City 2721
title: 2721 to Johnson City
tagline: RM 2721, 1320, and 1323 instead of 290. Lunch on the Johnson City square. Same roads home.
description: East on RM 2721 — pick it up off 1631 out of town — the sweeper that parallels 290 without the tasting-room traffic. Left on RM 1320 at Post Oak, right on RM 1323 at Sandy, right on 281 into Johnson City. Pecan Street Brewing on the courthouse square is the lunch. Proof & Cooper and Hill Country Cupboard are walking distance if the table wants a different plate. Come home the same way. Those three ranch roads are why you came, and they are still the best pavement back. 290 is the cheat. 1623 through Blanco, 1323 west to Willow City, and 1631 all the way to Althaus Davis / Horseshoe Bay are other drives from town, not a clever loop.
routeLabel: FBG → 2721 → 1320 → 1323 → 281 → Johnson City → same roads home
stops: RM 2721 at Post Oak — left onto 1320 toward Sandy. Stay off 290
Pecan Street Brewing, 106 E Pecan Dr — brewpub on the square. Open daily; Wednesday closes at 3
Proof & Cooper or Hill Country Cupboard — the other square plates if the group splits
gotchas: Pecan Street closes at 3 on Wednesday. Maps will offer 290 both directions — decline. Ranch traffic and hidden driveways on 2721. The 281 stub is just the last two miles into town. Bryan's on 290 is dinner-only, not this lunch. Stay on 2721 once you peel off 1631 — the rest of 1631 to 1323 is the Horseshoe Bay day.

name: Horseshoe Bay
title: Althaus Davis to Horseshoe Bay
tagline: 1631 to 1323 to Althaus Davis. Lake-view lunch in Cottonwood Shores. Same ranch roads home.
description: Stay on RM 1631 all the way out of town — do not peel onto 2721. That is the Johnson City day. Short east on 1323, then Althaus Davis (CR 310), paved through since about 2021 to RM 3347. 3347 to 962, north to 71, 2147 into Cottonwood Shores / Horseshoe Bay. Bay View Restaurant is the lake-view lunch. Julie's Cocina is next door if you want Mexican or Bay View is dark. Come home the same way. Those ranch roads are why you came, and they are still the best pavement back. 290 and 281 are the cheat. Willow City Loop is the other 1323 day. If you want a loop instead of an out-and-back, 281 south to 1323 west the long way to 1631 stays off 290 — more highway, less Althaus Davis, not twistier.
routeLabel: FBG → 1631 → 1323 → Althaus Davis → 3347 → 962 → 71 / 2147 → Horseshoe Bay → same roads home
stops: RM 1631 to 1323 — stay on 1631. 2721 is the Johnson City day
Althaus Davis Rd (CR 310) — the paved ranch cut onto RM 3347
Bay View Restaurant, 4401 Cottonwood Dr — lake view. Closed Tuesday
Julie's Cocina, 4319 FM 2147 — Mexican next door. Tuesday play; Sunday lunch ends 1:30
gotchas: Bay View is closed Tuesday. Julie's is open Tuesday and closes 1:30 on Sunday. No fuel on 1631, Althaus Davis, or 3347 — fill in town and at the lake. Cattle and thin county pavement. Maps will offer 16 or 290 — decline. Do not turn 2721. Do not go west on 1323 into Willow City Loop. 962 east of Round Mountain is Hamilton Pool / Austin, not home.

name: Devil's Backbone
title: Devil's Backbone Full Day
tagline: RM 32's limestone ridge east of Blanco. The famous bit is short. The day is the loop from FBG.
description: South on 1376 past Luckenbach — keep rolling — then RM 473 toward Kendalia and onto RM 32. That is the Devil's Backbone: a few miles of ridge between Fischer and Wimberley, not a canyon. Pull off at the overlook. The tavern is a honky-tonk pause, not lunch. Eat in Wimberley, then home on 2325 and 165 through Blanco, 1623 and 2721 into Fredericksburg. This is not the Blanco BBQ day and it is not a 290 transfer. Skip FM 306 around Canyon Lake.
stops: Devil's Backbone Overlook, RM 32 — the pull-off and the view. That is the reason for the extra miles
Devil's Backbone Tavern, 4041 FM 32, Fischer — honky-tonk pause. No kitchen; restaurant next door
The Leaning Pear, 111 River Rd, Wimberley — lunch Wednesday–Sunday. The square if Pear is dark Monday–Tuesday
gotchas: The famous ridge is a couple of miles — do not sell it as Twisted Sisters. Weekend motorcycle and Wimberley traffic. The tavern does not serve food. Leaning Pear is closed Monday–Tuesday; eat on the Wimberley square or grab Old 300 on the Blanco pass-through. Do not drop onto FM 306 / Canyon Lake. Glance Blanco; do not turn this into the BBQ day.

name: Hunt TX 39
title: Hunt + Guadalupe River Cruise
tagline: TX 39 along the river to Hunt, then Black Board Bar B Q in Sisterdale on the way home.
description: West out of Kerrville on the Guadalupe to Ingram and Hunt — camps, cypress, and a road that follows the water. Turn around at Hunt and come home on 27 through Center Point and Comfort, then RM 473 into Sisterdale for Black Board Bar B Q. That is the lunch, and it is worth timing the river for. Backroads into Fredericksburg after. Luckenbach is a glance on 1376 if you still want it.
routeLabel: FBG → Kerrville → Hunt → Comfort → Black Board, Sisterdale → home
stops: Hunt Store / the river pull-off — the turnaround, not a lunch destination
Black Board Bar B Q, Sisterdale — craft brisket on the way home. One of the best plates in the Hill Country
Backroads into FBG on 1376 — Luckenbach is optional if you still have daylight
gotchas: Black Board is Friday–Sunday for BBQ (Thursday is burger night). Closed Monday–Wednesday. Confirm hours; they sell out. Summer camp and tube traffic on 39. Crider's is evening / seasonal, not midday. Do not drop onto RM 1340 unless you want low-water crossings.

name: Bandera TX 16
title: Kerrville to Bandera on 16
tagline: The sweeper they mean by Highway 16. Medina as a via, Bandera for lunch, home on 173.
description: TX 16 south through Kerrville and Medina is the Hill Country 16 — sweepers, river crossings, ranch country — not the connector back to town. Land in Bandera, the Cowboy Capital, for lunch. Come home on 173 past Camp Verde so you are not retracing the same pavement. Skip the long orchard stop; that is the Medina pie day.
routeLabel: FBG → Kerrville → Medina → Bandera → Camp Verde → home
stops: Medina — fuel and a wave at the Apple Store, then keep rolling
O.S.T. Restaurant, Bandera — diner plates in the Cowboy Capital (check hours; Tue/Wed close early)
Camp Verde General Store on 173 — the historic pause on the way home
gotchas: Bandera weekends are cowboy-tourism busy. O.S.T. is not a late lunch on Tuesday or Wednesday. 16 has blind curves and ranch traffic. Do not turn this into the 337 / Lost Maples day.

name: Lost Maples
title: Lost Maples Fall Color
tagline: The seasonal scenic. Vanderpool, Sabinal Canyon, and a country-store pause.
description: When the bigtooth maples turn, this becomes the Hill Country drive people plan weekends around. Same corridor as the sisters, different reason to go — color, not curves.
routeLabel: FBG → Medina → Lost Maples SNA → home
stops: Lost Maples State Natural Area — the color is the destination
Lost Maples Country Store — fuel and a pause
Medina pie on the way out or back
gotchas: Peak color weekends fill the park and the road. Check foliage reports. Summer heat makes this a dawn start for motorcycles.
